types.name: BridgeAddress
docs: Remote bridge destination for a target chain (mirrors EVM `bridgeAddresses`); used as executor relay target.

fields.name: chain
docs: Wormhole chain id of the remote peer. Cannot equal `1` (Solana) except on devnet builds.

fields.name: address
docs: Remote bridge identity as 32 bytes (EVM contract or other encoding).

fields.name: bump
docs: Bump for bridge_address PDA.

fields.name: pending_owner
docs: Two-step ownership transfer candidate. Default (zero) = no transfer in flight.

fields.name: asset_mint
docs: Asset mint that this bridge instance operates on. PDAs for `BridgeConfig` and
related per-mint state derive from this pubkey.

fields.name: executor_program_id
docs: Wormhole Executor program id. Default = no Executor.

fields.name: executor_gas_limit
docs: Gas limit for execution on the destination chain (e.g. EVM). Passed in relay instructions
when bridging. Matches EVM gasLimit.

fields.name: paused
docs: Emergency pause flag. When true, bridge_ds_tokens and execute_vaa_v1 are disabled.

fields.name: bridge_authority_bump
docs: Bump for bridge_authority PDA.

fields.name: bump
docs: Bump for this config PDA (`[SEED_PREFIX, asset_mint]`).

fields.name: token_config
docs: Token-flow payload.

fields.name: _reserved
docs: Reserved trailing buffer for future upgrades.

types.name: DSTokenBridgeReceive
docs: Emitted by both the DS and SPL inbound flows.

types.name: DSTokenBridgeSend
docs: Emitted by both the DS and SPL outbound flows.

types.name: EmitterAddress
docs: Expected Wormhole `vm.emitterAddress` for a source chain (mirrors EVM `emitterAddresses`).

fields.name: chain
docs: Wormhole chain id of the source. Cannot equal `1` (Solana) except on devnet builds.

fields.name: address
docs: 32-byte emitter identity (EVM: padded bridge contract; Solana: emitter PDA).

fields.name: bump
docs: Bump for emitter_address PDA.

fields.name: min_consistency_level
docs: Required value of the VAA `consistencyLevel` byte for inbound messages from this emitter.

types.name: ExecutorAccountResolverResult
docs: Stores a large [`Resolver::Resolved`] payload when it does not fit in Solana return data (1024 bytes).
Discriminator matches Wormhole executor-account-resolver spec.

fields.name: version
docs: version of the account

fields.name: identity_registry
docs: identity registry to which the account belongs

fields.name: owner
docs: owner of the identity account

fields.name: num_wallets
docs: number of wallets attached to this identity account

fields.name: country
docs: country code of the user

fields.name: asset_mint
docs: corresponding asset mint

fields.name: authority
docs: authority to manage the registry

fields.name: authority
docs: Authority keypair allowed to write this account, will match authority or delegate of IdentityRegistry
at time of creation of IdentityAccount.

fields.name: identity_account
docs: IdentityAccount associated with this investor.

fields.name: identity_registry
docs: IdentityRegistryAccount associated with this investor.

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA Seed Bump

fields.name: investor_id
docs: Unique ID for Investor, generated off-chain.

fields.name: collision_hash
docs: Metadata for investor, generated off-chain.

fields.name: last_updated_by
docs: User that last modified this investor. Read from payer of instruction.

fields.name: levels
docs: Levels assigned to investor.

fields.name: level
docs: Maps to IdentityAccount level used in RWA Token.

fields.name: proof_hash
docs: Hash generated off-chain.

fields.name: batch_id
docs: nonce

fields.name: wormhole_message_hash
docs: Keccak256 hash of verified Wormhole message.

types.name: ResolverConfig
docs: Resolver configuration for Wormhole Executor integration.
Seeded by [emitter_chain, emitter_address] so the resolver can derive the
correct PDA from the VAA body without knowing the asset_mint upfront.
One ResolverConfig per foreign emitter registration.

fields.name: asset_mint
docs: Asset mint managed by this bridge instance (same as `BridgeConfig.asset_mint`).

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump seed.

types.name: TokenConfig
docs: Discriminated union describing the per-instance bridge configuration payload.
